mapper.select: SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS account_id, fc.owner_type, fc.connected_by_member_id, fc.child_id, fa.balance, fa.balance_updated_at FROM financial_account fa INNER JOIN financial_connection fc ON fc.financial_connection_id = fa.financial_connection_id LEFT JOIN child c ON c.child_id = fc.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE fa.financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId} AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fc.consent_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fc.revoked_at IS NULL AND ( fc.consent_expires_at IS NULL OR fc.consent_expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) AND ( fc.owner_type = 'PARENT' OR ( fc.owner_type = 'CHILD' AND c.child_id IS NOT NULL AND fa.child_id = fc.child_id ) )

SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS account_id, fc.owner_type, fc.connected_by_member_id, fc.child_id, c.name AS child_name, fa.organization_code, fa.bank_name, fa.account_name, fa.account_number_ciphertext, fa.account_product_type, fa.balance, fa.balance_updated_at, fa.account_status, fa.is_primary AS primary_account, fa.opened_at, fa.maturity_date, fa.linked_at, fa.goal_name_snapshot, fa.goal_target_amount, fa.goal_target_date FROM financial_account fa INNER JOIN financial_connection fc ON fc.financial_connection_id = fa.financial_connection_id LEFT JOIN child c ON c.child_id = fc.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE fa.financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId} AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fc.consent_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fc.revoked_at IS NULL AND ( fc.consent_expires_at IS NULL OR fc.consent_expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) AND ( fc.owner_type = 'PARENT' OR ( fc.owner_type = 'CHILD' AND c.child_id IS NOT NULL AND fa.child_id = fc.child_id ) )

SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS account_id, fa.organization_code, fa.bank_name, fa.account_name, fa.account_number_ciphertext, fa.account_product_type, fa.balance, fa.balance_updated_at, fa.account_status, fa.is_primary AS primary_account FROM financial_account fa INNER JOIN financial_connection fc ON fc.financial_connection_id = fa.financial_connection_id WHERE fc.connected_by_member_id = #{memberId} AND fc.owner_type = 'PARENT' AND fc.consent_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fc.revoked_at IS NULL AND ( fc.consent_expires_at IS NULL OR fc.consent_expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) AND fa.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY fa.is_primary DESC, fa.linked_at DESC, fa.financial_account_id DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE financial_account fa INNER JOIN financial_connection fc ON fc.financial_connection_id = fa.financial_connection_id SET fa.is_primary = CASE WHEN fa.financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, fa.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE fc.owner_type = 'PARENT' AND fc.connected_by_member_id = #{connectedByMemberId}
